policy.FULL_CANONICAL: Entire checked text exists in one UTF-8 file under song_archive/.
policy.FULL_LEGACY_SHARDS: Entire exact text is recoverable in checked historical shards, but no physically verified one-file canonical copy exists.
policy.TEXT_LOST: Performance/original composition survives in continuity but exact full text cannot currently be recovered.
policy.TITLE_ONLY: Title/performance is durable; exact lyrics are not.
policy.rule: Never fill missing user-adapted lyrics from web, the source song, semantic memory or a guessed reconstruction.
